scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (Vayoshreshtha Samman): Centenarian
description:
The National Award for Senior Citizens also known as Vayoshreshtha Samman is a prestigious recognition initiated by the Government of India.

This scheme was launched in the year 2005.

The primary aim of this award is to honor and recognize the contributions of senior citizens in various fields.

It specifically focuses on individuals aged 60 years and above.

The awards are conferred annually on the occasion of the International Day of Older Persons which is celebrated on October 1.

The awards are given in various categories to acknowledge the achievements of senior citizens.

The categories include individual achievements in fields such as social work, education, health, and arts.

The awards also recognize the contributions of organizations working for the welfare of senior citizens.

The objective of the Vayoshreshtha Samman is to promote the welfare of senior citizens.

It aims to create awareness about the issues faced by the elderly population in India.

The scheme also seeks to encourage the participation of senior citizens in community development.

The awards serve as a motivation for senior citizens to continue contributing to society.

The benefits of the Vayoshreshtha Samman include national recognition for the awardees.

Awardees receive a certificate of appreciation and a cash prize.

The cash prize for the awardees is set at INR 1,00,000.

In addition to the cash prize, awardees are also given a shawl and a citation.

The eligibility criteria for the Vayoshreshtha Samman are clearly defined.

Applicants must be Indian citizens aged 60 years and above.

There are no specific income criteria for this award.

The application process for the award is straightforward and accessible.

Interested candidates or organizations can apply online through the official website of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

The application form requires basic personal details and information regarding the contributions made by the applicant.

Supporting documents such as proof of age and evidence of contributions may also be required.

The applications are scrutinized by a committee formed by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

This committee evaluates the contributions of the applicants based on predefined criteria.

The timeline for the application process typically begins several months prior to the International Day of Older Persons.

The exact dates for the application process may vary each year.

However applications generally open in the month of July and close by the end of August.

The awards are presented in a formal ceremony organized by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

This ceremony usually takes place on October 1 each year.

The implementing authority for the Vayoshreshtha Samman is the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

The ministry is responsible for the overall management and execution of the award scheme.

Contact details for the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment can be found on their official website.

The ministry provides comprehensive information regarding the application process and eligibility criteria.

The Vayoshreshtha Samman has gained significant recognition over the years.

It has helped to highlight the valuable contributions of senior citizens to society.

The scheme also plays a crucial role in addressing the challenges faced by the elderly population.

According to the 2011 Census of India, the elderly population aged 60 years and above was approximately 104 million.

This number is projected to increase to around 173 million by the year 2026.

The Vayoshreshtha Samman aims to empower this growing demographic.

It encourages senior citizens to remain active and engaged in society.

The awards also serve to inspire younger generations to respect and value the contributions of their elders.

The initiative aligns with the broader goals of the National Policy on Older Persons.

This policy was formulated in 1999 and aims to improve the quality of life for senior citizens.

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is one of the key initiatives under this policy.

The scheme has also received positive feedback from various stakeholders.

Many organizations working for the welfare of senior citizens have praised the initiative.

They believe it plays a vital role in promoting the rights and dignity of older persons.

The Vayoshreshtha Samman has also been instrumental in creating a supportive environment for senior citizens.

It encourages community involvement and support for the elderly.

The awards have also led to increased awareness about the issues faced by senior citizens.

This includes challenges such as health care, social security, and financial independence.

The recognition provided by the Vayoshreshtha Samman helps to mitigate some of these challenges.

It provides a platform for senior citizens to share their experiences and contributions.

The scheme has also been linked to various other government initiatives aimed at improving the lives of senior citizens.

These include the National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly and the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme.

The Vayoshreshtha Samman continues to evolve to meet the changing needs of the elderly population.

It remains a significant initiative in promoting the welfare and recognition of senior citizens in India.

The awards not only celebrate individual achievements but also highlight the importance of community support for the elderly.

Through this scheme, the Government of India aims to foster a culture of respect and appreciation for senior citizens.

The Vayoshreshtha Samman is a testament to the contributions of older persons to society.

It serves as a reminder of the invaluable wisdom and experience that senior citizens bring to the community.
